job.title: Job
job.cached_note: This exact result is cached — identical requests, from anyone, are served instantly without recomputing. Every number is exact: this is the answer, not an approximation.
job.report_problem: Report a problem with this computation
about.body: A public interface to the quiverlab library for quivers with relations and exact Hochschild theory. Every number is exact; the library fails loudly rather than approximate.
about.cite: Cite: see the JOSS paper linked from the repository.
fb.intro: Report a problem or suggest a feature. No account needed.
lit.intro: The curated bibliography behind quiverlab's algorithms and families, grouped by topic.
big.warn: This computation builds ~{cells}-cell matrices (~{minutes} min, ~{mem} memory) — beyond the anonymous limit. Enter an email and we'll run it as a big job and email you when it's done.
big.disabled: This computation builds ~{cells}-cell matrices — beyond the anonymous limit, and large jobs are unavailable right now. Run it locally: pip install quiverlab.
big.reject: This computation builds ~{cells}-cell matrices, beyond the large-job limit of ~{maxcells} cells. Run it locally: pip install quiverlab.
big.sent: Check your inbox for a one-time link to run this job.
big.link_used: This link was already used or has expired. Submit the job again to get a new one.
big.queued: Your big job is queued. We'll email you when it's done — bookmark this page for the results.
offline.gpu_note: {n} GPU(s) detected — not used: quiverlab's engines are exact CPU computation.
mod.almost_split_refused: No almost-split sequence (M is projective, decomposable, or undecidable)
mod.tilting_no: M is not a tilting module
mod.orbit_rigid: M is rigid: Ext¹(M,M) = 0, so the orbit O_M is open (Voigt).
mod.orbit_codim_hered: A is hereditary, so dim Ext¹(M,M) IS the codimension of the orbit closure in Rep(Q,d) (Voigt; Rep smooth).
mod.orbit_codim_general: A = kQ/I is not hereditary, so dim Ext¹(M,M) is only an UPPER BOUND on the codimension (the module variety is cut by the relations).
mod.tor_unavailable: Tor requires the Tor engine (Plan 29); not available in this build.
mod.display_only: display only — these entries lie outside the integer/fraction input grammar (e.g. GF(p^n) elements) and cannot be re-entered in the module panel.
mod.stale_recompute: this result was computed by an older version and lacks the full representation — recompute to see the arrow actions.
mod.differentials_proj: differentials (rows: target basis, columns: source basis; d_0 = ε: Q_0 → M)
mod.differentials_inj: differentials (rows: target basis, columns: source basis; d^0 = ι: M → E^0)
mod.same_matrix: the same matrix as above; not repeated
mod.matrix_too_large: matrix too large to display; it is complete in the report data
mod.tau_target_ext: and for N, the Ext target:
mod.tau_target_tor: and for N, the Tor target:
draw.title: Draw a quiver and compute
draw.blurb: Click the canvas to add vertices, drag between vertices to add arrows, type relations, pick a field, choose what to compute. Everything is computed exactly by this app's own engine.
